intro.title: 1. Introduction
intro.content: Welcome to CardVault. We value your privacy and this Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, and protect your personal information.

collect.title: 2. Information We Collect
collect.content: When you use our service, we may collect the following information:
collect.item1: Google account information (name, email, profile picture)
collect.item2: Business card data you upload and create
collect.item3: Basic technical information when using the service

usage.title: 3. How We Use Information
usage.content: We use the collected information to:

sharing.title: 4. Information Sharing
sharing.content: We do not sell, trade, or transfer your personal information to third parties. We only disclose your information when required by law or to protect our rights.

security.title: 5. Data Security
security.content: We employ industry-standard security measures to protect your personal information. Your data is stored on secure servers and transmitted through encrypted connections.

rights.title: 6. Your Rights
rights.content: You have the right to access, correct, or delete your personal information. To exercise these rights, please use the settings function within the app or contact us.

cookies.title: 7. Cookie Usage
cookies.content: We use cookies and similar technologies to maintain your login status and improve service experience. You can manage cookie preferences in your browser settings.

changes.title: 8. Policy Changes
changes.content: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. For significant changes, we will notify you through appropriate means. Continued use of the service indicates your acceptance of the updated policy.

acceptance.title: 1. Acceptance of Terms
acceptance.content: Welcome to CardVault. By using our service, you agree to comply with these Terms of Service. If you do not agree with these terms, please do not use our service.

description.title: 2. Service Description
description.content: CardVault is a business card management application that helps users digitize, organize, and search business card information. We reserve the right to modify or terminate the service (or any part thereof) at any time.

responsibilities.title: 3. User Responsibilities
responsibilities.content: When using our service, you agree to:
responsibilities.item1: Provide accurate and complete account information
responsibilities.item2: Maintain account security and be responsible for all activities under your account
responsibilities.item3: Not abuse the service or engage in illegal activities
responsibilities.item4: Respect other users and our service

ip.title: 4. Intellectual Property
ip.content: The service and its original content, features, and functionality are owned by CardVault and protected by international copyright laws. The business card data you create belongs to you.

disclaimer.title: 5. Disclaimer
disclaimer.content: The service is provided "as is" without any warranties, express or implied. We do not guarantee that the service will be uninterrupted or error-free. You use the service at your own risk.

liability.title: 6. Limitation of Liability
liability.content: To the maximum extent permitted by law, CardVault and its affiliates shall not be liable for any indirect, incidental, special, consequential, or punitive damages.

termination.title: 7. Account Termination
termination.content: We reserve the right to suspend or terminate your account at any time if you violate these terms. You may also choose to stop using our service at any time.

changes.title: 8. Changes to Terms
changes.content: We may modify these Terms of Service from time to time. For significant changes, we will notify you in advance. Continued use of the service indicates your acceptance of the modified terms.
